dimensions.assessment: Affects landowners within the proposed boundary addition, the Forest Service, and individuals utilizing the National Forest System lands.
dimensions.evidence: The boundaries of the Talladega National Forest are modified to include the land depicted on the map

dimensions.assessment: Enables federal land acquisition and management under standard Weeks Law and National Forest System authorities for willing sellers only.
dimensions.evidence: acquire land, waters, and interests therein... from a willing seller by donation, exchange, or purchase

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes the use of donated or appropriated funds for land acquisitions from willing sellers, but states no specific total dollar figure.
dimensions.evidence: purchase using donated or appropriated funds

dimensions.assessment: Makes a specific geographical boundary modification to an existing national forest and applies standard existing forest management statutes to the added lands.
dimensions.evidence: The boundaries of the Talladega National Forest are modified to include the land depicted on the map

dimensions.assessment: Permanently alters the proclamation boundaries of the national forest and applies permanent National Forest System management to any acquired tracts.
dimensions.evidence: managed as land acquired under the Act of March 1, 1911... and in accordance with all laws and regulations pertaining to the National Forest System.

missing_information: The exact acreage of the land to be added to the Talladega National Forest.
The total financial cost or appropriated budget for acquiring the lands depicted on the map.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill modifies the boundaries of the Talladega National Forest to include specific lands and authorizes the Secretary of Agriculture to acquire private or public lands and interests within that boundary from willing sellers.
